description_html:
The Uwell Typhos Replacement Pod is a refillable replacement pod for compatible Uwell devices.

  • Product Type: Refillable Replacement Pod (Empty - Built-in Coil)
  • Coil Resistance: 0.6Ω / 0.8Ω (built-in, varies by pod)
  • Coil Material: Mesh
  • Compatible Devices: Uwell Typhos, Typhos Pro, Typhos SE
  • Brand: Uwell

Coil is built in - replace the pod when flavour fades. E-liquid sold separately.

Available options: 0.6OHM (3ML), 0.8 OHM (3ML).
